protocol.clock_limits: Snapshot clocks/P-state are not a sustained-clock guarantee. Nongrouped initial/final snapshots reported P0 and throttle mask 0; initial idle-before SM clock was 180 MHz, initial after 2370 MHz, final both 2407 MHz. Memory clock was 12481 MHz; no clock setting was applied.
protocol.grouped: interleaved-v1: initial 30 per side; fixed risk/history OR initial ratio >=0.99 requires both 200-sample orders. All four prefill representatives require both confirmations. These 16 decode cases did not trigger confirmation.
protocol.nongrouped: Each case: 30/200/200 per side, ABBA x3 / ABBA x10 / BAAB x10; graph decode and original eager paths, including FP6 prefill; cold L2; no trimming.

redaction: Allowlisted fields only; no private absolute paths, endpoints, hostnames, GPU UUIDs, PIDs, allocator/capture bindings or source snapshots. Grouped original monotonic block times retained; nongrouped wall-clock block timestamps omitted, original order and ranges retained.
reproduction: The external xcheck corpus and formal drivers have no public fetch entry here and are not provided by this repository. Exact dirty/untracked after sources, safety sources, original sanitizer logs and full lifecycle records are not published. These measurements cannot be reproduced from this repository alone; clean before is distinct from dirty after. Published exports are raw timing and selected correctness summaries, not self-contained lifecycle replay.
comparison: Nongrouped A=clean before_b12x_base, B=after_b12x_base plus dirty/untracked inputs; ABBA/BAAB uses those arms. Grouped A=DeepGEMM, B=b12x measured after tree, not before/after. Ratios are median B / median A, lower is better; every required phase must be <=1.01. Case IDs join the companion exports; shape and recorded kernel_id describe each case, not an execution address.
measurement_context_definition: File-local context-1 joins both review exports to source, hardware and observed_versions in this provenance. It identifies this collection's monotonic clock domain only, not a task or source revision. Grouped case file order is not timing order.

context-1.monotonic_scope: grouped blocks in this collection only

resource_scope: Observed nongrouped objects: no increased dynamic SMEM, static SMEM 1024 bytes, frame/stack 0, no LDL/STL. Positive GPR deltas remain; case (and kernel where specified) joins the nongrouped resources. Not a census of all production objects. Units and opaque CuTe program keys are defined in ../grouped-fp8.md.

safety_behavior.predecessor: Caller-output direct_out eligibility checked overlap/gradient state against original inputs and all derived a_codes, a_scale, alpha and row-scale tensors. Ineligible output used an internal result followed by copy semantics.
safety_behavior.measured_after: The fresh_internal predicate skips only the derived-buffer overlap/gradient checks when the large-M per-row quantization branch created those buffers internally. Original x/x_bf16, weight, scale_storage and global_scale checks remain; the normal direct_out layout/dtype/device/shape/alignment/correction/version checks still apply. Small-M/persistent or otherwise nonfresh paths still check derived buffers. This is host eligibility behavior, not a changed GEMM kernel.
safety_behavior.count_unit: Parameterized test instances, not unique functions or a production-kernel census. Original sanitizer command/node subsets and logs are not published; the counts below are historical summaries, not independently replayable coverage.

safety_boundaries: Separate predecessor source: normal 20 caller-output + 5 FP6 regressions; memcheck 5, racecheck 3, synccheck 3, all passed without skips/errors.

Measured after source: normal 20 caller-output + 5 FP6 regressions; memcheck 5 direct/alias/capture instances, all passed without skips/errors. Racecheck/synccheck were not repeated for this host-only predicate change; predecessor coverage does not qualify after for those tools.
Formal performance data are not a sanitizer matrix. Historical failed performance attempts remain failures and are not included as passing phases.
scope_limits: 10 nongrouped cases and 20 grouped representatives only. Neither a new 819-case nor 446-case matrix, SM121 qualification, whole-upstream suite, or EP1/EP8 scaling acceptance. Historical semantic 3 and semantic 4 exports remain separate.

source.reproduction_limit: Git bases plus dirty/untracked inputs identify the measurement context, not a reconstructible clean source. A later commit does not retroactively identify this tree.
